subject: Re: AlphaSpark accelerator — promo mapping & credit stacking
messages:
From: Sara Levin <sara@alphaspark.vc>
To: hiro_tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@alphaspark.vc
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: AlphaSpark accelerator — mapping of promo credits and stacking question

Hi Hiro,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we start the procurement path:

1) We have an internal accelerator allowance of $10k in cloud credits per cohort. Can those be mapped to Redwood "free credits" (promo credits) so they show up against usage for reporting?

2) Does Redwood allow promo credits to be stacked with an early-stage committed discount (we're evaluating a 6-month reserved capacity commit for demo environments)? If so, how does that affect billing and invoice line-items?

I attached our draft credit schedule (credit_schedule.xlsx) and a simple MA plan — curious whether you need anything else for legal. Procurement asked for the mechanics so they can draft the PO.

Sara
Sara Levin
Head of Accelerator Ops — AlphaSpark VC
From: hiro_tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Levin <sara@alphaspark.vc>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AlphaSpark accelerator — mapping of promo credits and stacking question

Sara — thanks, glad the demo was useful. Quick answers up-front and then a proposed next step:

- Mapping credits: Yes — we can associate external promo/allowance credits to an account and they will appear as a separate line in usage reports. That mapping is done at onboarding and requires the credit schedule + an internal allocation table so Finance can reconcile.

- Stacking with reserved commit: We can support a promo-credit overlay on top of a committed discount. Practical effect: promo credits consume usage first (zero-dollar token consumption) and the commit discount applies only after credits are exhausted. For accounting, we provide a breakdown by token bucket: promo, commit-discounted, and overage. Invoice will show promo as a line-item credit and the commit as a discounted usage tier.

What we need from you to proceed: the final credit schedule (we can use your attached xlsx), confirmation of the reserved capacity sizing, and the legal contact for the MSA/PO workflow. Marissa — can you take point on drafting the billing appendix and a stub invoice showing the mechanics? Ben — FYI on sales terms/approval for a stacking exception (if procurement requests a carve-out where commit applies before promo).

If that all sounds right I can loop legal for a quick redline and schedule a 30-min ops call Thursday.

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
